body:
36 Westhill Drive (Z-25-22)
Changes to the Zoning Bylaw for this location are required before a permit can be issued. This means that they submit an application that is reviewed by city planners and other agencies plus city council before anything can be built. The Applicant has withdrawn its initial request to amend the Official Plan (OPA 73) to allow a maximum building height of 8 storeys.
BlackDoor Development Company is proposing to build a new 6-storey apartment building at 36 Westhill Drive
Zoning bylaw changes requested include:
change the zoning from Future Determination (FD) to Residential Mixed-Use 20 (RMU-20)
reducing the minimum landscaped open space from 30% to 20.5%
reducing the low rise residential lot line setback to 5.4m from the southerly lot line
reduce the residential parking rate from 0.9 spaces/unit to 0.85 spaces/unit
allow a 1.5-metre balcony projection into the front yard
allow a portion of structured parking in front of building floor area
View the documents submitted by the development company under supporting documents on this page for more details and drawings.
Building height, units, housing types
Tallest building: 6 storeys
Number of units: 140
Unit sizes: mix of one and two bedrooms
Housing types: apartments
Parking
Parking: 135 [36 structured parking and 99 surface spaces]
Bicycle parking: 96
You can provide feedback to the planning department, and it will be shared with the council, or ask a question to learn more about this application.
Images are provided by the applicant and may not reflect the final design approved by the planning division.
